lines.text: Endmin, that gate in front of you... Have we seen it before?
Um... Oh, right! It looks just like that other cave where the LBs stash their loot!
Maybe we should head in and take a look. We might strike gold.
The gate is unnaturally solid. No ordinary force can get it to open...
The note writes: "The sky is ⟦key|sunny⟧ but yet it ⟦key|rains⟧. Can we still find our ⟦key|friend⟧? Or are things flipped over on its end?"
Great! The gate is finally open!
Nothing's happening... Maybe this isn't the right sequence...

scenes.summary: The Landbreakers' "treasure trove" you find happens to be the missing UWST gel-cotton. You call Satyr to collect his explosives and conclude the mission.

lines.text: Ah! I just remembered! These must be the gel-cotton explosives that Satyr mentioned! The Landbreakers actually hid them here...
Endmin, we should call Satyr right away. His crew should carry these explosives back to their sites. I really don't want anything bad to happen...
